Totally get it – picking can feel like choosing a movie on a Friday night, too many good options at once.
Here’s a quick cheat sheet based on how you’ll use it:
All‑day massive hydration / festivals / gym crew: Big Mouth Bottle (2L or 4L) – keeps drinks cold up to 72 hours and hot up to 48 hours, leak‑proof, great with ice and even fizzy or alcoholic drinks.
Everyday hot + cold, straw option: Series 2 Switch Cup (500ml or 750ml) – insulated, double‑walled, works for coffee, tea, smoothies and fizzy drinks. Use cup mode for hot, straw for cold. Hand‑wash only.
Commuter coffee / hot drinks on the go: Series 2 Coffee Cup (340ml or 500ml) – twist mechanism lid, very good at preventing leaks when upright, keeps drinks hot for hours. Hand‑wash only; don’t use with very hot liquids on their side.
General water bottle, everyday carry: Series 3 Bottle (350ml, 500ml, 1L) – 90% recycled stainless steel, double‑walled, keeps drinks cold 36–60 hours, flip version 45–75 hours, 100% leak‑proof and BPA‑free.
On‑the‑go eating: Chilly’s Cutlery Set – stainless steel fork, knife, spoon, straw + brush in an aluminum/recycled‑plastic case, great for lunches and picnics, with key parts dishwasher‑safe (top rack).
Need to spread payments (UK, £60+ order): You can use Klarna Pay in 3 or Pay in 30 days with no interest when you pay on time.
If you tell me whether you mainly want water, coffee, smoothies, or food on the go, and roughly how much you drink in a day, I can narrow this down to one or two perfect picks for you.

Choose lower-value gift cards (£10, £25) and even combine multiples if needed.
